title: Object Stamp Flow - extract an object from one image, place it into another
description: Dev-gated Flow: put a SPECIFIC object from one photo into another - an exact gun, an exact headphone model, a logo on a cup, an image replacing a painting - and have it look really photographed there. Stage 1 takes the scene and the object. Stage 2 is a canvas with a 1:1 box, an Auto/Manual toggle (Auto default), a Remove Background toggle and an erase/restore brush. Auto shows the object itself and sends the clean scene plus the stamped composite; Manual shows an empty box with no rotation handle plus a prompt field, and sends the cropped scene plus the clean object. ONE dispatch on Klein 9B (4B tested and failed), Draw It In's crop -> edit -> ColorMatch -> stitch topology. Design settled and validated live over ~25 app runs 2026-08-26; two earlier designs dropped. Read brief.md then prompts.md.
acceptance: A new dev-gated Flow in flowsRegistry.js takes two image inputs: image1 = the scene, image2 = the object to place
requiredModels is a model SLOT on klein-9b ONLY - 4B was tested and failed - and modelParams carries the matching CLIP (qwen_3_8b_int8_convrot), because the text encoder moves with the checkpoint

Stage 2 is ONE step carrying a 1:1 box, an Auto/Manual toggle defaulting to Auto, a Remove Background toggle and an erase/restore brush - built from existing components (ShapeManager 'place' mode, the removeBackground branch, the add/subtract brush), never a bare form control

Auto shows the object on the canvas and dispatches slot 1 = clean scene, slot 2 = stamped composite; Manual shows an EMPTY box with NO rotation handle plus a prompt field, and dispatches slot 1 = cropped scene, slot 2 = clean object at full frame
The dispatch never sends more than TWO references in either mode - three causes identity mixing and drew two objects in testing

bgMask and userMask stay two layers composited only at dispatch, so toggling Remove Background never destroys the user's erasures; the brush works with the toggle off; every mask mutation records an UndoStack entry
A step can reach a second media role via a new `sourceRole` on the step declaration, mirroring the existing mediaRole - a step on image1 can see image2

The graph is ONE dispatch: composite -> InpaintCropImproved -> Klein 9B edit -> ColorMatch -> InpaintStitchImproved, with the crop sized so the placement clears the ~200px anchor threshold and shadows do not clip at the return edge
Both baked prompts match prompts.md and sit in the 40-120 word band; the Manual prompt field is declared on the STEP and nowhere else, and no undeclared Input_Positive node is left in the graph
A case is added to tests/inject-params-titles.test.cjs; npm test AND npm run test:desktop are green
Live-run BOTH modes and a reuse round trip pass per docs/playbooks/add-flow/05-verify.md
The angle limitation is stated in the stage-2 hint copy - supply the object photographed from roughly the angle you want - rather than engineered around
docs/playbooks/add-flow/existing-flows/object-stamp.md is added, and the generalisable laws are promoted into blending-into-a-photo.md
The flow is announced in docs/releases/UNRELEASED.md in BOTH the roster list and its own entry
Tile still and hero clip ship via /mpi-flow-graphics, cut from the runs already in the Stamp Flow Tests project
